limitations: Mock dataset — no live cloud API credentials used.
Recommendations are advisory; implementation requires change management.
Cost savings are illustrative estimates, not invoiced amounts.

recommendations.title: Resize underutilized production VM SKU
recommendations.description: Average CPU below 15% over 30 days; smaller SKU may meet SLO.

recommendations.title: Enable cluster autoscaling and rightsizing
recommendations.description: Dev cluster nodes idle overnight; autoscale policy not configured.

recommendations.title: Enable soft delete and versioning on audit storage
recommendations.description: Audit bucket lacks immutability controls required by retention policy.

recommendations.title: Configure cross-region read replica
recommendations.description: Single-region database without documented failover runbook.

recommendations.title: Standardize diagnostic settings across resource groups
recommendations.description: 12 resource groups missing centralized diagnostic export.
